# Copilot instructions

Repository-wide agent policy lives in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repository
root. Follow that file.

Do not add policy, precedence, or delegation rules here. This file exists only because
GitHub Copilot loads `.github/copilot-instructions.md`; it MUST remain a pointer.
